generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A normative concurrency clause can be missed when a detector recognizes only a narrow noun vocabulary around concurrent actors or responses.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Mark concurrency risk not applicable because the lexical detector misses phrases describing simultaneous responses, callbacks or messages.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: When normative text describes two or more concurrent response-like actors or a single-winner conclusion, classify concurrency-atomicity as applicable.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Lexical precision tests must include at least two synthetic concurrent actor surfaces and a non-concurrency semantic competitor false-positive case.

transfer_cases.input: two callbacks arrive concurrently and only one conclusion may commit
two messages are processed simultaneously for one pending state

skill_changes.evidence: Generic concurrent response/message/callback lexical recognition added without target-specific identifiers.
Synthetic concurrency and false-positive lexical precision tests passed; genericity validator also passed.
